g.text: 2 | Low-load finite-mesh continuum reference vs LPS
FEM maximum relative free-force residual = 5.11e-13; maximum |2U − u·R| / (2U) = 1.51e-14.
G refinement stability does not certify volumetric-field convergence. Model / boundary / horizon effects remain unseparated.
LPS solver energy uncertainty is approximately 10⁻¹⁷ J; errors shown here are distinct from material uncertainty.
